h200.source: Security/Definitions/Core/Accel/H200.lean (data sheet: 1,979 dense INT8 TOPS over 2 x 132 SMs at 1830 MHz; HBM3e 4.8 TB/s); the achieved HBM share for decode's stock step is an assumption

w1.source: W1 / MH100w: every instruction at 32 units or more a 32-bit register written; an m16n8 MMA writes 128 accumulator words a warp, whatever its depth (PTX ISA: m16n8k32 s8, m16n8k64 u4/s4, m16n8k256 b1 and.popc)

sha512.source: the H32 floor of hm96 rows, the bar for SHA-512 on the GPU, and the store of a word to HBM, in W1 units

lead.source: the lead (ssn-1l-tag + blc4a-t64-rot, served, k32, 256 KiB words chunks): alpha and a k32 word every 32 lanes (4 alpha / 32 bytes a MAC), its card's hashing price, its network term at caps 32 / 320 at that price, its measured T2 (sync, async) over the points' stock steps, the coin round trips a step, and its raw coin stream

llama_3_2_1b.source: Llama-3.2-1B config: hidden 2048, intermediate 8192, 32 q heads, 8 kv heads, head dim 64; fused qkv and gate-up as served; KV cache in bf16

points_source: stock steps (sync, async) and the linears' GEMM time of the three points as the card's; decode steps are an estimate: the int8 linears' weights and the bf16 KV cache read at the achieved HBM share; prefill attention is causal, so its mean context is half the sequence

links.source: 400 Gb/s a GPU (an HGX H200's compute-fabric NIC); a GEMM's worst slowdown under a concurrent device-to-host stream (measured on one H200); SHA-512 on one Genoa core

egress.source: OutsourceWithinEgress (Security/Definitions/Pouw/Guarantees/DitherInstance.lean): n_max W_mac E / stock, caps at a 4-byte token id a token and ten times that

accounting.source: one H200 at its dense int8 peak times 0.4 utilization; the datacenter (benchmarks/census/deployments.json dc-12500-machines-600s); the world (adversary.json world-inference-2027); AND gates an int8 MAC
